03258 Ya`bets {yah-bates'}

字根已不使用, 可能意為悲傷;

AV - Jabez 4; 4

雅比斯= "憂傷"
陽性專有名詞
1) 迦勒家的族長
專有名詞,地名
2) 靠近伯利恆猶大境內的一城鎮 (#代上2:55|)
record.edic_text:
03258 Ya`bets {yah-bates'}

from an unused root probably meaning to grieve;;

AV - Jabez 4; 4

Jabez = "sorrow"
n pr m
1) the head of a Calebite family
n pr loc
2) a town in Judah apparently near Bethlehem
